appearance: Baby about one year old: bronzed brown skin, tuft of black hair, dark eyes. Grown: tall, lean Egyptian man with bronzed reddish-brown skin and short black hair.
name: Wedja
nameNote: Reconstructed name (Egyptian 'wedja', whole, safe). Alternatives: Ankh, Tjau, Iteru.
summary: Nebet's baby son in Episode 1; his crying draws the herders who save them. Seen grown and strong at the end, a fisherman on the Nile with children of his own.
wardrobe: as a baby: wrapped in soft leather in his mother's sling; grown: short leather kilt, fishing net
